items.q: How far in advance should I order?
items.a: At least 2–3 days. We roast over wood for your date specifically, so we need the time to prepare. For fiesta season, Christmas and New Year, book earlier — those dates fill up fast.
Yes — free anywhere within Allen, Northern Samar. For anywhere outside Allen, message us and we'll see what we can do.
Tell us your pax count in Messenger and we'll advise. As a guide, lechon belly serves 5–20 pax and whole lechon serves 20–70 pax.

items.q: Why is belly priced by raw weight and whole lechon by live weight?
items.a: They are two different measures. Lechon belly is quoted by its raw weight before roasting. Whole lechon is quoted by the pig's live weight. When you compare the two price lists, you are comparing different bases — so go by the pax count, not by price per kilo.

items.q: What comes with a whole lechon order?
items.a: Every whole lechon comes with dinuguan, free. Lechon belly orders do not include the dinuguan freebie.
